title: Faith's effects toward Cap.17; against idle faith
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): CHAPTER SEVENTEEN follows, On ye consequences and effects belonging toward Christian faith. — Faith's effects—union with God, evangelical justification, sanctification, peace belonging toward conscience—are treated in ye next chapter. — Living faith stands as not idle but effective through love (Gal. 5:6); yet it justifies alone—not insofar as it works, but insofar as it apprehends Christ.
pass_b_english: Living faith is not idle but effective through love (Gal. 5:6); yet it justifies alone—not insofar as it works, but insofar as it apprehends Christ.
Faith's effects—union with God, evangelical justification, sanctification, peace of conscience—are treated in the next chapter.
CHAPTER SEVENTEEN follows, On the consequences and effects of Christian faith.
source_text: Fides viva non est otiosa sed per charitatem efficax (Gal. 5:6); tamen iustificat sola, non quatenus operatur, sed quatenus Christum apprehendit. Effecta fidei—unio cum Deo, iustificatio Euangelica, sanctificatio, pax conscientiae—sequenti capite tractantur. CAPUT DECIMUM SEPTIMUM sequitur, De fidei Christianae consequentibus et effectis.
